name: Fresh Ripe Mango Slices (Soft & Peeled)
whyItWorks: Soft, fiberless varieties of mango (like Ataulfo / Honey mangoes) have a creamy, custard-like texture that provides vitamins A and C without stringy cellulose. Soluble fiber predominates.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Choose Ataulfo or fully ripe Tommy Atkins mangoes. Cut flesh away from the flat center pit and peel off the tough waxy skin completely.
watchOuts: Avoid stringy, fibrous fibrous mangoes where stringy hairs get caught in digestion.
